subject: Linguistics
title: Pragmatics and AI
description: A micro-lesson that makes Pragmatics and AI usable.

hook.text: Ask a chatbot 'Can you tell me the time?' and it might say 'Yes, I can'—missing the real request.

buildup.text: AI systems struggle with pragmatics because indirect meaning isn't in the words themselves.

discovery.text: Sarcasm detection, implicature resolution, and politeness calibration remain hard for machines.

twist.text: Large language models are getting better—but they learn patterns, not true pragmatic reasoning.

climax.text: Making AI pragmatically competent would make human-computer interaction feel natural.

punchline.text: True understanding requires reading between the lines.

quiz.question: Why is pragmatics hard for AI?
options: Indirect meaning isn't in the literal words
